title: Per-part packs: a platform's index.json
description: Generated from js/glb.ts PARTS_INDEX_FIELDS: do not edit (npm run check:models -- --write). See docs/models.md.

platform.description: The platform (gun id) the packs are for.

src.description: Hash of the recipe sources the packs came from (stale-pack detection).

slots.description: Every build slot seen in the platform's builds: the ones `anchors` is keyed by.

dep.description: The build slots whose parts shape this tag: a pack's `key` lists a part for each, in this order.

key.description: A part id per `dep` slot ("" = the slot is empty; "*" = any part).

oneOf.description: The pack's file under the platform folder (or `_shared/<slot>/<file>.glb` under the parts folder: stored once for every platform); null when the tag is empty for this key.

file.description: The pack's file under the platform folder (or `_shared/<slot>/<file>.glb` under the parts folder: stored once for every platform); null when the tag is empty for this key.

oneOf.description: A shared pack: the move [forward, up, right] metres that places its stored geometry on this platform.

at.description: A shared pack: the move [forward, up, right] metres that places its stored geometry on this platform.

oneOf.description: The part_ nodes the pack has meshes in (info.anim keys, before the meshes are loaded).

nodes.description: The part_ nodes the pack has meshes in (info.anim keys, before the meshes are loaded).

packs.description: The packs: the most specific matching key is used.

tags.description: Per mesh slot (tag): which build slots shape it and its packs.

anchors.description: Offsets parts give other slots: "<buildSlot>=<partId>" -> { mount_<tag>: [forward, up, right] } (metres, added up over the build).

dep.description: The build slots whose parts the table's leaves depend on: a row's `key` lists a part for each, in this order.

leaves.description: The info leaf paths (a/b/0: segments joined by "/", array indices as numbers) the rows give.

key.description: A part id per `dep` slot ("" = the slot is empty; "*" = any part).

v.description: The value of each leaf, in the order of `leaves` ({ "del": 1 }: the leaf is absent).

rows.description: One row per combination of parts: the most specific matching key is used.

info.description: The `info` leaves as tables: each leaf is a function of the parts in some slots, and leaves with the same slots are one table.
